If you like several eOS programs, you can install them fairly easily on other Debian-derived systems like Mint and Ubuntu.

Take for example the Noise eOS music program. All you need to do is add the repository of elementary OS apps to your Mint, Ubuntu, or Debian list of repositories. Open up a terminal and run the following:

sudo apt-add-repository ppa:elementary-os/stable
sudo apt-get-update
sudo apt-get-install noise

Edit: a little explanation of the commands run:

  1. Adds the stable elementary OS repository of programs to your list of repositories, which allows you to install the list of programs in the repository: https://launchpad.net/~elementary-os/+archive/ubuntu/stable
  2. Updates the package lists for all your repositories so that you get the latest versions of the packages in the repositories
  3. Install noise music player
